title: Promising shovel efficiency hud
description: makes a green number that tells the efficiency enchant level to the hotbar slot where the shovel is and updates instantly.
body:
Tired of opening your inventory just to check your shovel's Efficiency? 

This tiny client-side mod made for hypixel skyblock that renders your Promising Shovel's current Efficiency level as a bright green number right on its hotbar slot, and it updates in real time the instant the enchantment changes. 

No configuration needed — download Fabric api, drop them in and go.
